Definition
[Transition maps between complementary components]

Source: morgan-tian

For compact $K\subset K'\subset X$, inclusion of complements induces \[ \pi _0(X\setminus K')\longrightarrow \pi _0(X\setminus K), \] sending each component to the unique component containing it. Each $\pi _0$ carries the quotient topology.
